formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p67_t2_multiword_product_error (fp : P67FPModel) (p n : ℕ) ... : absolute error ≤ gamma_(n+p²−1) times the sum of absolute constituent products
formal_statement.plain_language: The high-precision accumulation of p² constituent word-pair products obeys the exact-split bound of equation (2.5).

informal_proof: Apply the γ_n inner-product backward error independently to each of the p² word pairs; apply γ_(p²−1) recursive-summation backward error to their rounded totals; compose the factors into γ_(n+p²−1).
informal_statement: For p-word exact representations of two operands, one entry formed from p² rounded constituent inner products and their rounded accumulation has error at most γ_(n+p²−1) times the absolute sum of all constituent products.
paper_version: 2023 author-hosted 19-page publisher PDF, journal pages C1–C19

tier_rationale: For arbitrary positive p and inner dimension n, L calls distinct substantial dotProduct_backward_error and recursiveSum_backward_error results. N reconstructs both variable-length numerical analyses, then composes their errors. The target is the exact-split p-word one-entry instance of source equation (2.5), including its γ_(n+p²−1) constant. No fixed-size outer sum shortcut remains.
